parties: Hexagon Nutrition Limited; Dr. Nikhil Kelkar (Promoter and Joint Managing Director)
headline: Dr. Nikhil Kelkar acquires 16,400 equity shares in Hexagon Nutrition Limited
sum: Promoter and Joint Managing Director Dr. Nikhil Kelkar of Hexagon Nutrition Limited acquired 16,400 equity shares, triggering mandatory disclosure under SEBI's substantial acquisition regulations. The acquisition was intimated to NSE on 19 August 2026 under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI Takeovers Code.
implication: Promoter share acquisitions by board-level insiders require real-time Regulation 29(2) disclosure to the exchange and trigger insider trading window compliance reviews; the materiality threshold and band-crossing mechanics define when such acquisitions become public knowledge.
detail: Dr. Nikhil Kelkar, holding the dual role of Promoter and Joint Managing Director at Hexagon Nutrition Limited, acquired 16,400 equity shares. The transaction was disclosed to NSE via formal intimation on 19 August 2026 under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 29(2), which mandates disclosure of acquisitions that cross statutory thresholds or are material to the company. No acquisition price or total consideration was disclosed in the filing.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 29(2)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement for substantial acquisition of shares by promoters and related parties; triggers within 2 trading days of crossing threshold.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992, Section 15
framework.note: Empowers SEBI to regulate takeovers and substantial acquisitions to protect shareholder interests.
Directors must disclose their interests in contracts and related-party transactions to the board.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 3
framework.note: Promoters and key management personnel must comply with blackout periods during trading windows; acquisition may trigger review of window compliance.

framework.ref: Listing Agreement / NSE Regulations, Chapter IV
framework.note: Continuous disclosure obligations require listed entities to notify exchanges of material corporate actions and promoter shareholding changes.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
framework.note: Listed entities must disclose material events and changes in shareholding of promoters within prescribed timelines.
